Question: Assalam o alaikum I am a pesh Imam of a masjid a member of committee in our masjid has put a false allegation on me that of stealing the money from the masjid acount and I with my full Iman havent done this.what does the sharriah tells about this?looking for justice by quran and sunnah? Answer ID: 1356 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1190/916=H) It is Haram and a major sin to accuse even a common person of theft so what about accusing an imam. This case must be solved mutually with wisdom and understanding. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
